cve_summary: ImageMagick 7.0.6-2 has a memory leak vulnerability in WriteMAPImage in coders/map.c.
docstring:
Summary:  
Unregisters the "MAP" image format from the Magick library and writes an image to a file in MAP format, including colormap bytes and pixel indexes.

Parameters:  
image_info (const ImageInfo *): Contains information about the image to be written.  
image (Image *): The image object that is being processed.

Returns:  
MagickBooleanType: Indicates success (MagickTrue) or failure (MagickFalse) of the write operation.

Logic: The function first validates the input parameters and opens the output file for writing. It transforms the image colorspace to sRGB and allocates memory for the colormap and pixel data. It then writes the colormap to the file, handling both 256-color and higher-color images. Finally, it writes the pixel indexes to the file. If any memory allocation fails, it throws an exception.

judge_vs_vulnerable.rationale: Implementation 1 performs explicit null checks on the result of AcquireQuantumMemory and GetImagePixels, and also checks the return value of fopen. It also includes bounds checks for image dimensions. Implementation 2 relies on assertions and assumes memory allocation and file operations succeed, but does not perform explicit null checks or bounds checks on image dimensions. Implementation 2 uses WriteBlob and OpenBlob, which may encapsulate some defensive logic, but this is not visible in the code.

reference_missing_steps: explicit error handling for file open/write
judge_vs_fixed.rationale: Implementation 1 performs explicit null checks for the image_info filename and image dimensions, and includes detailed error handling for file operations and memory allocation. It also checks the return value of GetImagePixels. Implementation 2 relies on assertions and assumes the input is valid, but includes a single combined check for both memory allocations and uses WriteBlob/CloseBlob for file operations, which may encapsulate some defensive logic. Implementation 2 also includes a check for the return value of GetVirtualPixels. Neither implementation includes a check for the return value of TransformImageColorspace.
